# Hausio

> Hausio is a London home-services company offering cleaning, man and van / removals, handyman, building works, plumbing, garden maintenance, furniture assembly, TV mounting, garden clearance, waste removal and painting & decorating across Greater London. Vetted, DBS-checked, £2M insured, eco-friendly, with £0 to pay until the job is done.

## Key facts

- Service area: all 32 London boroughs (Greater London).
- Prices: cleaning £30/hr one-off, £27/hr regular, £45/hr deep (5-hour minimum per cleaner), man and van from £65/hr, handyman £65 first hour then £50/hr, furniture assembly from £45/hr, TV mounting from £55, garden clearance from £120, waste removal from £55, painting £220/painter/day.
- Pricing: full current rates, minimum booking times and common extras at https://hausio.co.uk/pricing.html, https://hausio.co.uk/pricing.json and https://hausio.co.uk/pricing.md.
- Booking: itemised online estimate at https://hausio.co.uk/book.html — the final quote is confirmed after review; pay £0 at booking and settle by card/Apple Pay/Google Pay after the job.
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 08:00–20:00.
- Trust: DBS-checked and reference-vetted staff, £2M public liability + £25k goods-in-transit cover.
- Common charges: an £18 access charge inside the Central London Congestion Zone and a £15 same-day surcharge can apply. Cleaning products, larger-home supplements, moving mileage and selected service extras are itemised when relevant. There is no weekend or evening premium within 08:00–20:00.
- Minimums: Cleaning: 5 hours. Man and van: 3 hours. Handyman: 2 hours.
- Legal entity: Hausio Ltd, registered in England & Wales, company number 17167561 (https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/17167561).
- Machine-readable company facts: https://hausio.co.uk/business.json.
- Phone: +44 7304 330614. Email: hausio.co.uk@proton.me.

## Services

- [Cleaning in London](https://hausio.co.uk/cleaning-london.html): one-off £30/hr, regular £27/hr, deep £45/hr, end-of-tenancy £32/hr and after-builders £30/hr; 5-hour minimum per cleaner. Optional products +£15 per visit.
- [Man and van in London](https://hausio.co.uk/man-and-van-london.html): single items to full flat/house moves from £65/hr, same-day available.
- [Handyman in London](https://hausio.co.uk/handyman-london.html): repairs, assembly, mounting, minor plumbing and electrics — £65 first hour.
- [Building works in London](https://hausio.co.uk/building-works-london.html): tiling, wallpapering, groundworks and foundations, exterior work and glazing — quoted per project after scope review.
- [Plumbing in London](https://hausio.co.uk/plumbing-london.html): household leaks, taps, toilets, wastes, appliance connections and radiator work — quoted after the fault and parts are reviewed.
- [Garden maintenance in London](https://hausio.co.uk/garden-maintenance-london.html): lawn mowing, hedge trimming, pruning, weeding and one-off or regular seasonal care — quoted for the garden.
- [Furniture assembly in London](https://hausio.co.uk/furniture-assembly-london.html): IKEA, Made.com, Wayfair — from £45/hr or fixed price by item.
- [TV wall mounting in London](https://hausio.co.uk/tv-mounting-london.html): plasterboard, brick, concrete, cable-conceal — from £55.
- [Garden clearance in London](https://hausio.co.uk/garden-clearance-london.html): overgrowth, sheds, decking — from £120, registered waste carrier.
- [Waste removal in London](https://hausio.co.uk/waste-removal-london.html): single items to full house clearance — from £55, transfer notes included.
- [Painting & decorating in London](https://hausio.co.uk/painting-decorating-london.html): single rooms to whole flats — £220/painter/day, prep included.

## Areas

Every one of the 8 services has a dedicated page for each of the 32 London boroughs — 256 local pages in total, at `https://hausio.co.uk/{service}-{borough}.html`, where `{service}` is one of `cleaning`, `handyman`, `man-and-van`, `furniture-assembly`, `tv-mounting`, `garden-clearance`, `waste-removal`, `painting-decorating`, and `{borough}` is the borough slug (e.g. `camden`, `hackney`, `tower-hamlets`, `waltham-forest`, `hammersmith-fulham`, `kensington-chelsea`, `barking-dagenham`, `richmond`, `kingston`).

Each local page carries that borough's postcodes, ULEZ and controlled-parking-zone position, local pricing and borough-specific FAQs. Examples:

- [Cleaners in Camden](https://hausio.co.uk/cleaning-camden.html): NW1, NW3, WC1 — regular £27/hr to end of tenancy £32/hr.
- [Handyman in Camden](https://hausio.co.uk/handyman-camden.html): £65 first hour, then £50/hr, 15–30 min response across the borough.
- [Man and van in Hackney](https://hausio.co.uk/man-and-van-hackney.html): E5, E8, E9, N1, N16 — £65/hr for 1 man + van.
- [Cleaners in Tower Hamlets](https://hausio.co.uk/cleaning-tower-hamlets.html): E1, E2, E3, E14 including Canary Wharf.
- [Handyman in Waltham Forest](https://hausio.co.uk/handyman-waltham-forest.html): E4, E10, E11, E17 including Blackhorse Road.
- [Garden clearance in Bexley](https://hausio.co.uk/garden-clearance-bexley.html): DA1, DA5–DA8, DA14–DA16, SE2, SE9 — inside extended ULEZ, no charge passed on.
- [TV mounting in Westminster](https://hausio.co.uk/tv-mounting-westminster.html): W1, SW1, WC2 including Oxford Street.
- [Painting & decorating in Wandsworth](https://hausio.co.uk/painting-decorating-wandsworth.html): SW11, SW12, SW17, SW18.

- [All London borough hubs](https://hausio.co.uk/areas/): index of all 32 hubs, each listing every service for that borough at `https://hausio.co.uk/areas/{borough}.html`.

## Company

- [About Hausio](https://hausio.co.uk/about.html): our story (started by two cleaners who built a team of trusted professionals through moving jobs), vetting, insurance, company details and how we work.
- [How it works](https://hausio.co.uk/how-it-works.html): the booking-to-completion process in four steps.
- [FAQ](https://hausio.co.uk/faq.html): pricing, booking, insurance, payment and access questions.
- [Full pricing](https://hausio.co.uk/pricing.html): current rates, minimum booking times and common extras for every service.
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://hausio.co.uk/pricing.json): current rates and booking minimums as JSON.
- [Compact pricing text](https://hausio.co.uk/pricing.md): the same current price facts in plain text.
- [Book / instant estimate](https://hausio.co.uk/book.html): get an itemised estimate online; the final quote is confirmed after review.
- [Customer reviews](https://hausio.co.uk/leave-a-review.html#reviews): read published customer reviews or share a Hausio experience with photos.
- [Become a Hausio partner](https://hausio.co.uk/partners.html): application page for independent cleaners, handymen and small local teams in London. Partners choose their areas and availability; Hausio handles bookings, customer messages and payment, and keeps a 10% service fee on the agreed labour price (e.g. £100 labour = £90 partner payout). Applying does not guarantee acceptance or a minimum number of jobs.
